# 4 Ezra Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Third vision

---

**6:1** And he-said to-me: At-the beginning of-the-circle-of-the-earth, before the-portals-of-the-world were-in-place, and before the-assembled-winds blew,

**6:2** and before the-voices-of-the-thunder sounded, and before the-flashes-of-lightning shone, and before the-foundations-of-paradise were-laid,

**6:3** and before the-beautiful-flowers were-seen, and before the-powers-of-movement were-established, and before the-innumerable-hosts-of-angels were-gathered,

**6:4** and before the-heights-of-the-air were-lifted-up, and before the-measures-of-the-firmaments were-named, and before the-footstool-of-Zion was-established,

**6:5** and before the-present-years were-reckoned; and before the-imaginations-of-those-who-now-sin were-estranged; and before those-who-stored-up-faith-for-a-treasure were-sealed —

**6:6** then I thought it over, and these things were-made through-me and through-none other; as also the-end shall-come through-me and through-none-other.

**6:7** Then I answered and said: What-will-be the-dividing-of-the-times? or-when-will-be the-end-of-the-first and the-beginning-of-that-which-follows?

**6:8** And he-said to-me: From Abraham to-Isaac, when-Jacob and Esau were-born-of-him, Jacob's-hand held-from-the-beginning the-heel-of-Esau.

**6:9** For Esau-is-the-end-of-this-age, and Jacob-is-the-beginning-of-that-which-follows.

**6:10** The-hand-of-man is-between the-heel and the-hand; other question seek-not, Ezra.

**6:11** I answered and said: O-LORD, my-lord! if-I-have-found-grace before-your-eyes,

**6:12** I pray-you, show-your-servant the-end-of-your-signs, of-which you-showed-me part on-the-previous-night.

**6:13** And he-answered and-said to-me: Rise-up upon-your-feet and you-will-hear a-full-resonant-voice.

**6:14** And if-the-place-where-you-stand-is-greatly-moved,

**6:15** fear-not when-it-speaks; for it-is-about the-end and the-foundations-of-the-earth-will-understand

**6:16** that the-speech is-about them: they shall-tremble and be-shaken; for they-know that their-end must-be-changed.

**6:17** And it-came-to-pass when-I-heard-it, I-stood-up upon-my-feet and-listened, and behold, a-voice-was-speaking, and the-sound-of-it-was-like-the-sound-of-many-waters.

**6:18** And it-said: Behold, the-days come, and it-shall-be when I-begin to-draw-near to-visit-the inhabitants of-the-earth,

**6:19** and when I-begin to-make-inquisition of-those-who-have-wrongfully-done-wrong, and when the-humiliation-of-Zion-shall-be-complete,

**6:20** and when-the-seal-shall-be-set upon-the-age which-is-about-to-pass-away — then will-I-show these-signs:

**6:21** the-books-shall-be-opened before-the-face-of-the-firmament, and all-shall-see-it together;

**6:22** and the-children-of-a-year-old shall-speak-with-their-voices, and the-women-with-child shall-bring-forth-untimely children-of-three-and-four-months, and they-shall-live and-be-quickened.

**6:23** And suddenly-shall-the-sown-places-appear-unsown, and the-full-storehouses-shall-suddenly-be-found-empty;

**6:24** and the-trumpet-shall-sound-aloud, and-when-all-hear-it, they-shall-suddenly-be-terrified.

**6:25** At-that-time-shall-friends-fight-one-against-another like enemies, and the-earth-shall-stand-in-fear together-with-its-inhabitants because-of the powers-of-the-thunder.

**6:26** And after these-things, if-the-Most-High grants-me-to-live, I will-speak to-you the-things that-I-shall-see; and the-confusion-of-the-nations shall-be-in-the-hand-of-the-Most-High, who-shall-see-it when-he-will.

**6:27** Then answered-I and-said: All-that-I-ask in-every-case, O-LORD, is-this: why-have-I-been-given-the-power-of-understanding?

**6:28** For it-was-not in-my-mind-to-ask about-the-ways-above, but about-those-things which-we-daily-experience: why-is-Israel-made-a-reproach-before-the-Gentiles, why-is-the-people-which-you-loved-given-over-to-blasphemous-nations, why-is-the-law-of-our-fathers-become-as-nought, and the-written-covenants-come-to-nothing?

**6:29** And we pass-by-in-the-world as-grasshoppers, and our life-is-an-astonishment-and-a-fear; and we-are-not-worthy-to-obtain-mercy.

**6:30** But what-shall-he-do to-his-name that-is-called-over-us? Of-these-things-I-ask.

**6:31** Then answered-he-me and-said: The-more-you-search, the-more-you-shall-wonder; for the-world-hastens-fast-to-pass-away,

**6:32** and is-unable-to-comprehend the things that-are-promised-to-the-righteous-in-time-to-come; for this age is-full-of-sorrow and infirmities.

**6:33** For-the-evil which-has-been-sown among-us has-not-yet borne-complete-fruit in-us; and the-field where-evil-was-sown has-not-come-to-perfect-harvest.

**6:34** And-if-the evil-shall-not-have-been reaped where-it-was-sown, there-shall-not-come-the-field-of-him-that-sows-good.

**6:35** For-a-grain-of-evil-seed-was-sown-in-the-heart-of-Adam from-the-beginning; and how-much-impiety-has-it-brought-forth-until-now, and-shall-yet-bring-forth-until the-floor-of-threshing-come!

**6:36** Reckon-now-for-yourself how-great a-fruit-of-iniquity a-grain-of-evil-seed-has-produced.

**6:37** When-the-ears-shall-have-been-cut-off which-are-without-number, how-large a-floor-will-they-fill!

**6:38** Then-I-answered and-said: How-long? When-shall these-things-be? Why-are-our-years-few-and-evil?

**6:39** And-he-answered and-said to-me: Do-not-hasten-beyond-the Most-High; for-you-are-eager for-yourself-alone, but-the Exalted-One is-eager for-many.

**6:40** Were-not the-souls-of-the-righteous asking-the-same-things in-their-treasuries: When-shall-I-receive-my-fruit, O-LORD? When-shall-the-threshing-come?

**6:41** And-the-archangel-Jeremiel answered-them: When-the-number-of-those-like-you-shall-be-complete; for-he-has weighed-the-world-in-the-balance.

**6:42** By-measure has-he-measured-the-times, and-by-number has-he-numbered-the-seasons; and-he-shall-not-move nor-stir-things until the-said-measure-is-fulfilled.

**6:43** Then-I-answered and-said: O-LORD, you-who-art-above-us, we know-all-this; but-behold, we-who-shall-be-saved, and-who-shall-be-saved through-your-ways — when-shall-we-come-to-the-inheritance-which-you-have-promised-us?

**6:44** And-he-answered me and-said: You-shall-receive-it when-the-number-previously-spoken-of-is-fulfilled; for-the-Most-High has-made-this-age for-many, but-the-world-to-come for-few.

**6:45** But-I-will-tell-you-a-parable, Ezra: as-when-you-ask-the-earth, and-she-shall-say to-you: She-gives-much-clay from-which earthen-vessels-are-made, but-little-dust from-which gold-comes — so-is-it-also in-the-course-of-this-age.

**6:46** I-answered and-said: Might-you-not-have-made-those-who-have-been-and-who-are and-who-shall-be at-once, so-that you-might-show-your-judgment the-sooner?

**6:47** Then-he-answered and-said: The-creature cannot-hurry beyond-the-Creator; neither-can-the-world-hold-at-once all-those-who-shall-be-created-in-it.

**6:48** Then-I-said: How-has-he-spoken to-your-servant that-you-will-make-alive-at-once all-your-creature — that-those-who-are-kept-in-the-earth, and-those-who-are in-forgotten-places, and-those-who-dwelt-in-the-sea, shall-come-back-together?

**6:49** And-he-said to-me: Signs-shall-be-given; when-the-womb-has-opened, which-was-closed; and-when that-which-has-been-kept-in-it-shall-be-given-out — for-the-son-shall-not-be-kept-in-unless-there-be-a-vessel-to-hold-him.

**6:50** And-since-you-have-asked-me-about-fire and-wind and-the-day, behold-I-say-to-you:

**6:51** As-by-three-streams-the-waters-of-great-rivers are-mingled to-make-them-one, so-shall-many-signs-be-shown-to-those-who-dwell-upon-the-earth at-the-last.

**6:52** Then-I-answered and-said: Lord-God, you-showed-me signs-on-the-previous-night, though-you-showed-me-not all-of-them.

**6:53** Tell-me-now: this-land which-I-asked-about — when-will-it-be-desolate?

**6:54** And-he-said to-me: when I-arise-to-execute-judgment-upon-the-earth, then-comes-the-liberation-of-the-righteous, and-the-end-of-the-works-of-the-wicked.

**6:55** The-sun-shall-not-shine-upon-the-people-who-have-forsaken-my-covenant, nor-shall-the-light-of-the-moon-illuminate-them.

**6:56** The-lightning-shall-not-appear-unto-them, neither-shall-the-radiance-of-the-stars-shine-upon-them; but-darkness-only-and-terrible-scenes-shall-appear-to-them.

**6:57** But-to-the-righteous-there-shall-be-the-light-of-the-sun-seven-times-as-bright.

**6:58** And-I said: O-LORD, you-showed-me this-land; and-the-Most-High-made-this-age for-many, but-the-age-to-come-only-for-few:

**6:59** Shall-we-then-not-enjoy-it?
